odayakakizokunokyuukanosusume.query: Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume
odayakakizokunokyuukanosusume.title: A Gentle Noble's Vacation Recommendation (Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume.)

characters.desc: He was an aristocrat who served as the prime minister of a large nation in a certain world, but one day he was suddenly transported to another world. After being transported to that world, he became an adventurer and decided to enjoy life in another world, calling it a "vacation". He has a very calm way of speaking and behaving, and is also endowed with an excellent mind.

Nicknamed "The Blade," he is the strongest adventurer. He has a mean look in his eyes. He is skilled in human combat and monster subjugation. He also has a high ability to sense presence, making his abilities as an adventurer impeccable. Originally, he was a lone wolf who didn't flatter or obey anyone, but after meeting Lizel, he became his partner.

A snake-like beastman. He is a solo adventurer. He has a charming smile, but contrary to his appearance, he has a very aggressive and violent personality. He has the flexibility and speed of a snake itself, and is skilled in the use of weapons.

He is an employee of the Adventurer's Guild in the royal capital of Parteda. He rarely expresses emotions and generally remains expressionless at all times. Due to his emotionless appearance and the ice-element magic he uses, adventurers fear him and call him "Absolute Zero." He is adept at anything from desk work to heavy lifting. He is an old friend of [Judge](https://anilist.co/character/380597/Judge).

A tall man who runs a tool shop in the royal capital of Parteda. He has a timid personality and is reserved with everyone he interacts with. However, he can also make assertive statements at times. He has an excellent eye for appraisal, and sometimes helps appraise labyrinth items and monster materials brought to the Adventurer's Guild.

A middle-aged nobleman who manages the military police, he holds the title of Viscount. He is sociable and can talk to anyone casually, and does not often abuse his power. Furthermore, his refreshing appearance makes him very popular among the townspeople. He is also a "labyrinth item collector," and acquires items of interest through the Adventurer's Guild and auctions.

He is the lord of the commercial city of Marcaid. He is friends with [Insigh](https://anilist.co/character/380601/Insigh). He is extremely busy as he is involved in all economic activities in Marcaid. With a few exceptions, he hides his identity from the people of the territory, so he is almost completely unknown within the territory.

[Judge's](https://anilist.co/character/380597/Judge) grandfather, who runs a trading business based in the commercial city of Marcaid. He is renowned as a major merchant who has a great influence on domestic and international logistics. He is skilled at reading the world and proposing new products, and never misses a business opportunity. He dotes on Judge.
